reason: Parent predeclared closest qualifying station independently for each element, superseding same-station preference before weather/outcome join. Coverage and distance only; no model evaluation. An airport sensitivity remains separately reported because primary archive availability is not certified.
method: For each of TMAX, TMIN, PRCP choose the nearest station with >=90% unflagged nonmissing daily coverage; locations and all candidates preserved.
forecast_model_declared_by_parent: Month fixed effects plus linear time and these weather features; OLS last 48 eligible released months, minimum 36. Satellite must beat this baseline.
availability_assumption: Month end +14 days is an assumption for comparable measurements, not evidence that current archive values were available then.
